# We'll collect nodes at depth 3
nodes_at_depth_3 = set()

while queue:
    node, current_depth = queue.popleft()
    
    # If we've reached the desired depth, add to result
    if current_depth == depth:
        nodes_at_depth_3.add(node)
        continue  # Don't explore further from this depth
    
    # If we haven't reached the desired depth, explore neighbors
    if current_depth < depth:
        for neighbor in adj_list[node]:
            if neighbor not in visited:
                visited.add(neighbor)
                queue.append((neighbor, current_depth + 1))

# Convert to sorted list for consistency

print(f"Nodes at depth 3: {result}")
